raw_sections.summary:
Regulatory Compliance | Trade & Market Surveillance | Conduct Risk | AML/KYC
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Compliance Officer with 9+ years of experience in regulatory compliance, AML/KYC, trade and market surveillance, and conduct risk management across Citi, UBS, and BNY Mellon. Skilled in compliance monitoring and testing, policy development, regulatory reporting, and internal controls; experienced in identifying market abuse, insider trading, and regulatory breaches, and leading governance and remediation efforts with senior stakeholders. Proven ability to translate regulatory requirements (AML, KYC, sanctions, OFAC) into practical, risk-based controls and to build automation tools that improve compliance efficiency.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management: Regulatory Compliance, Compliance Framework Development, Policy & Procedure Development, Risk Assessment, Conduct Risk, Regulatory Change Management
AML/KYC & Financial Crime Prevention: AML/KYC, Sanctions Screening & OFAC Compliance, Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), Customer Due Diligence, Trade & Market Surveillance, Market Abuse & Insider Trading Monitoring
Governance, Controls & Reporting: Compliance Monitoring & Testing, Internal Controls, Governance Forums, Regulatory Reporting, Remediation & Escalation Management Stakeholder Management: Cross-functional Collaboration, Senior Stakeholder Engagement, Global Team Leadership Tools & Technology: Bloomberg, Factiva, Capital IQ, Qlik Sense, Total Conduct, Actimize, Advanced Excel
●
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Assistant Manager – Risk & Compliance | Citi
Oct 2022 – Aug 2026

Conduct compliance monitoring, surveillance reviews, and risk assessments to identify market abuse, insider trading, and regulatory breaches across global business lines, closing the highest alert volumes in the team with zero quality findings.
Analyse 6000+ high-volume compliance alerts monthly across Treasury & Trade Solutions, Research, and Securities Services, ensuring adherence to


internal policy and regulatory standards. Lead governance forums and partner with cross-functional teams to strengthen internal controls, close control gaps, and drive remediation of compliance issues. Prepare and present APAC Management Information, compliance dashboards, and regulatory risk metrics to senior stakeholders, supporting risk-based decision-making.
Manage escalations across global compliance, risk, and business teams, ensuring timely resolution of high-risk cases in line with regulatory expectations. ● Built and deployed AI-assisted surveillance triage support that cut manual review time by roughly 30% and improved consistency in flagging potential compliance issues.
AML Analyst | UBS
Dec 2020 – Sep 2022



Performed name screening, sanctions screening, and enhanced due diligence (EDD) for high-risk counterparties, assessing adverse media and financial crime risk. Supported the Singapore-based Centre of Excellence on AML investigations and cross-border compliance reviews across APAC, handling 150+ cases per quarter. Prepared APAC Management Information reports on screening volumes and compliance risk metrics, improving reporting turnaround for regional stakeholders by 20%.
KYC Analyst | BNY Mellon
Oct 2019 – Dec 2020

Conducted periodic KYC reviews, AML screening, and customer due diligence for corporate and institutional clients in line with global regulatory requirements.
Analysed corporate ownership structures and Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) information using regulatory filings and public databases to support risk-based decisions.
Utilized LexisNexis for due diligence, entity verification, and customer risk assessments, maintaining 100% on-time completion of assigned reviews.
Market Research Associate | Lucintel
Jul 2017 – Jun 2019
●
Conducted industry research, market sizing, and competitive benchmarking using Capital IQ, Bloomberg, and Factiva to support consulting engagements. Prepared client-ready research reports and investment insights for senior management, contributing to a 15% increase in repeat client engagements.
